title: Derive explicit native-lift phase tags and signed-word certificates
body:
PR3987 proves that the source's canonical binary lift can accumulate an even-linear phase character, including its actual inverse witness. This adds an explicit normalization tag and an arbitrary signed-word certificate for that same source convention.

Set D|x>=i^wt(x)|x> and J_G=D P_G D†. Then J_H J_G=J_HG exactly, K_G=J_G Z_tG, and ell(G,H)=tG+GᵀtH+tHG. The coordinate formula for tG and its polar/parity proof apply in every positive dimension. The tool tracks chronological pullbacks, distinguishing a canonical binary-inverse lift from the actual adjoint. These are elementary normalization results; the general cocycle proof and inverse-defect witness remain Chris R/Clear1nsight's PR3987 credit.

The phase tags also specify the required frame compensation: K_B C K_B†=J_B(Z_tB C Z_tB)J_B†. For the source primitive C_u, an anticommuting tag gives Z_t C_u Z_t=i C_u†, including the mandatory global i. Dropping tags or this global phase changes the operator. Switching to J requires compensated children, recipe rebinding and a paid physical contract. The author's existing correct adjoints and native recipes are unchanged. No free Pauli, native tariff, supplier or new κ is claimed.

Validation at exact head d593941ea0a4926021cba9d01fe60500579e464f, tree0176da010b09a1fdd96235e13508f8bcadd80261:

- Separate implementation imports no primary/predecessor executable: all168 GL(3,2) maps, all28,224 ordered pairs/all8states,5,376 compensated frame columns,2,688 naive-frame mismatches, four actual9-bit maps/all512states, eight signed prefixes and1,024 central-C branch columns.
- Twelve API cases plus eight actual CLI source/certificate mutations give40 normal/-O rejections; six independent source rejections. Controls distinguish transpose/order, wrong adjoint, omitted tags and missing global i.
- Exact16-file byte/source-history preflight and official export/check pass. All three standalone commands pass normal/-O under isolated Python, empty PATH, noGit, all17files0444/all directories0555; hashes, modes and inodes unchanged. Export SHA256:69a0abd39c86e51b846c8e39502141ae1a521ef84d16529f7d95354a0e61e560.
- [Hosted run39225559003](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39225559003) passes at this exact head:265 onboarding tests, only this package selected, all three commands onCPython3.12.15 and unchanged committed inputs. Finite checks corroborate the written general lemma; no human/kernel acceptance or complete native/selected-cold replay is claimed.

Scope:16new files only under research/native-lift-phase-tags/, one canonical-main parent20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90. Six exact PR3987 exports at fc536202fdaa924158789a5ef59ac079bbe21922 are retained locally, including original line endings/notices. No unmerged Git object or external input is needed at runtime. The four G maps are only its changed-interface subset, not the full PR3945 inventory. Reproduce: python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-lift-phase-tags.

Handoff-first follow-up, changed scope of independent-moment / scope_key c191650c0fa8d2fa514e. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3987#issuecomment-6263187495 . Main/priority6 refreshed unchanged at entry and prepublication. Complete702-open-PR-body coverage plus newest100-body delta through4000 and live1166/current-source comments; broader Discussion/closed/code coverage partial. No matching explicit normalization follow-up identified, without an exhaustive novelty claim.

Next: pin one actual physical interface and price its compensated tags/central children and every owner/helper/routing/precision charge before expansion. A wider alphabet with translations or nonmonomial children requires extra signed relations; this certificate covers K_G and its adjoint only. Physical/full-bill and all-size obligations remain open.
